notes: Both 'that' clauses are added under rule 55: the Hebrew juxtaposes the clauses with no conjunction in either, and the word may not be folded into מָקוֹם, into the adverb or into the copula beside it.
s007/s015 take the supplied 'in' as adverbial accusatives of place under rule 33; the preposition is never the head, which stays on 'place'.

s010-s011 and s018-s019 (שָׁמָּה) fuse the adverb with its directive he under rules 30 and 32, and the verbless clause's copula joins that adverbial predicate (rule 20's ruling that the anchor may be of any kind).
